title: Dereth Town Tour - Silyun scratch

shots.standingOrder: Climb in a widening helix from 9 m to 66 m around the statue, radius 14 to 30 m, half a turn counter-clockwise; stay within 30 m of the statue until above z 130 (the giant-tree tops) and 8 m from every tree.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (drone.helix around the plaza). Starts 14 m south of the 9 m Statue of Eleonora at 9 m height, corkscrews counter-clockwise past the east side and up to 66 m above the plaza, 30 m north over the great hall: the statue, flower bed, blue-flame lamps, golden hall roof and finally the whole mesa town among its giant trees. Radius kept under 28 m until above the tree tops (z 128); closest giant tree 8.6 m (box) at t 11 s. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (7548.1,45399.4,89.1) end (7549.9,45442.9,146.1), min AGL 9.1 m, nearest static/building/tree 8.6 m (0x27EC#92 0x0200129A), peak 8.6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Slide 22 m east 12 m in front of the great hall at 2.5 m height, panning partly to hold the balcony; nothing within 3 m of the lens.
shots.notes: FACADE PAN (drone.parallax-slide; Viamontian great hall). Camera line along y 45424 from x 7539 to 7561, 2.5 m above the plaza and 12 m from the hall's south face, pitched up 22 deg: columns, the golden roof, the balcony with braziers, paper lanterns and purple stag banners slide past with the lamps and benches in the foreground (parallax); late sun rakes across from the west. Nearest object 3.7 m (flower tuft). Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (7539.0,45424.0,82.5) end (7561.0,45424.0,82.5), min AGL 2.5 m, nearest static/building/tree 3.7 m (0x02001293@7566,45428), peak 2.9 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Hold behind the statue's right shoulder 7 m up and look past it to the Grand Mother on the balcony; never closer than 1 m to the statue.
shots.notes: BRAZIER FX + NARRATIVE (classic.over-the-shoulder, statue as the secondary). Camera 3 m behind and 2 m right of the 9 m statue at its shoulder height (z 87.4), telephoto (auto fov ~33 deg) on the hall balcony 26 m away: the Grand Mother between the two brazier flames and paper lanterns, the stone shoulder of Eleonora soft in the foreground (look.dof focus 26 m, range 10). shots.standingOrder: Handheld push 1.5 m toward the open forge from 7 m north-east at eye height; stay 5 m from the flames and clear of the porch columns.
shots.notes: FORGE FX (classic.handheld). Documentary push-in on the smithy porch from bearing 40: forge fire glowing in the shaded NE porch between the stone columns, anvil, bellows, hanging chains and the blacksmith; gentle 0.5 deg / 1 Hz operator shake. shots.standingOrder: Pull back from the blue-flame lamp and rise to 25 degrees over the plaza, revealing statue, hall and town; keep 2.5 m from the flower beds and benches.
shots.notes: CLOSING (classic.pull-out-reveal). Starts 4 m from the golden lamp's blue flame tongue at eye height (bearing 200) and pulls out and up to EWS 29 m away at 25 deg elevation (z 94): the lamp shrinks to a blue spark beside the statue of Eleonora, with the great hall and the town behind in warm late light.
